evaluation.summary: 4.3/5.0 - Well-structured three-phase migration strategy with schema registry and deployment patterns, missing concrete .proto code examples
evaluation.key_strengths: Directly addresses independent producer/consumer deployment with a clear three-phase migration strategy and enforces schema governance via Schema Registry validation before Kafka ingestion.
